findings.evidence: `Matrix.traceLinearMap` requires `Semiring`, `Matrix.trace_mul_comm` requires only additive commutative-monoid and commutative multiplication, `Matrix.ext_iff_trace_mul_left/right` require `NonAssocSemiring`, and `LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap` is defined under `[CommSemiring R]` (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Trace.lean:91,158,274,282`; `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Basic.lean:676`).
findings.fix: Use `[CommSemiring R]` for the core bilinear/quadratic sections, adding `[CommRing R]` locally to `traceBilinForm_lieInvariant`, `traceAdjointSO` and the CAR section.
findings.issue: The global `[CommRing R]` over-specializes `traceBilinForm`, its matrix-unit/symmetry/nondegeneracy lemmas, `traceQuadraticForm`, and its polar/nondegeneracy lemmas; these constructions naturally work over a commutative semiring. Keep `CommRing` only for the Lie and Clifford declarations.

summary: The decidable-equality issue is fixed, but the core trace and quadratic-form API still assumes additive inverses unnecessarily.
